draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package only reports training on original labels (exp1). No perturbation/noise condition exists, so robustness to label noise cannot be assessed. The claim has no support and no defensible narrower version remains.
